optional_editor_extensions.why: Python language support, environments, testing; the base every other Python tool builds on
fast type checking, completions and go-to-definition for Python
Cursor's own Python language server, in place of Pylance which Cursor may not use
Python debugger: breakpoints in scripts, tests and notebooks
Ruff linter and formatter: catches bugs and keeps research code tidy, in milliseconds
Jupyter notebooks and kernels inside the editor, on the server's Python
official viewer and cleaner for CSV, Parquet and DataFrames (the CSV/Parquet viewer)
work on the Linux research server over SSH as if it were local
Cursor's own Remote-SSH, in place of Microsoft's which Cursor may not use
YAML validation and completion (CI, configs, job specs); its telemetry is turned off below
review and merge GitHub pull requests and issues without leaving the editor
Claude Code in the editor, sharing the harness setup in ~/.claude
the Codex IDE extension, sharing ~/.codex/config.toml and AGENTS.md with the CLI

draft-message.check_contract: Reconcile factual details against named sources; exact sending authorization is outside this selection.
draft-message.output_contract: A preview draft with checked names, dates and purpose; sending is separate.
draft-message.reversal: Reselect on changed project, request/authority, source or tool availability; no persistent settings to undo.

project-reconcile.check_contract: Resolve each completion claim to evidence; mark unknown ownership and conflicting decisions explicitly.
project-reconcile.output_contract: Current objectives, trade-offs, owners, dependencies, conflicting status and next checks.
project-reconcile.reversal: Reselect on changed project, request/authority, source or tool availability; no persistent settings to undo.

reproduce-science.check_contract: Check original protocol, data identity, tiny/sample/full admission, independent oracle and uncertainty; no job is started by selection.
reproduce-science.output_contract: Bounded reproduction plan and evidence, fixed metric/seed/environment and retained negative results.
reproduce-science.reversal: Reselect on changed project, request/authority, source or tool availability; no persistent settings to undo.

source-notes.check_contract: Check requested source coverage, citation resolution and unsupported claims; preserve missing evidence.
source-notes.output_contract: Source-linked notes with page/section coverage and explicit inference labels.
source-notes.reversal: Reselect on changed project, request/authority, source or tool availability; no persistent settings to undo.

skills.description: Run long or costly data jobs, training or migrations small first, then a sample, then in full. Use before jobs touching many files or rows, or running for minutes.
skills.name: data-job-trial-run

skills.description: Find a bug's root cause before changing code. Use when something fails, throws or misbehaves and the cause is not obvious.
skills.name: debug-systematically

skills.description: Production bar for code you write or change - errors, logging without secrets, tests that catch breakage, lint, and the checks before saying done.
skills.name: production-code

skills.description: Inspect shared task handoffs and maintain evidence-backed memory during multi-step work.
skills.name: session-memory

skills.description: Quality bar for tests, evals, gates and review - test tiers, real gates, tests that cannot fail. Load before writing a test or eval, or reviewing a diff.
skills.name: standards

skills.description: Show real evidence before saying done, fixed or working. Use before any completion claim, hand-back, commit or pull request.
skills.name: verify-before-done

skills.description: Default loop for research, coding and dev-ops - analyse, research, plan, execute, test, loop back where the evidence points. Use for any task beyond a one-line change.
skills.name: work-loop

skills.description: Write a failing test first, make it pass, then prove the tests catch breakage. Use when adding behaviour, fixing a bug, or changing untested logic.
skills.name: write-tests-first
